text: Some time afterward, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision: Do not fear, Abram! I am your shield; I will make your reward very great.
But Abram said, "Lord God, what can you give me, if I die childless and have only a servant of my household, Eliezer of Damascus?"
Abram continued, "Look, you have given me no offspring, so a servant of my household will be my heir."
Then the word of the Lord came to him: No, that one will not be your heir; your own offspring will be your heir. [AA]
He took him outside and said: Look up at the sky and count the stars, if you can. Just so, he added, will your descendants be. [AB]
[AC] Abram put his faith in the Lord, who attributed it to him as an act of righteousness. [2]
He then said to him: I am the Lord who brought you from Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land as a possession. [AD]
"Lord God," he asked, "how will I know that I will possess it?"
[3] He answered him: Bring me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon. [AE]
He brought him all these, split them in two, and placed each half opposite the other; but the birds he did not cut up.
Birds of prey swooped down on the carcasses, but Abram scared them away.
As the sun was about to set, a deep sleep fell upon Abram, and a great, dark dread descended upon him.
[4] Then the Lord said to Abram: Know for certain that your descendants will reside as aliens in a land not their own, where they shall be enslaved and oppressed for four hundred years. [AF]
But I will bring judgment on the nation they must serve, and after this they will go out with great wealth. [AG]
You, however, will go to your ancestors in peace; you will be buried at a ripe old age.
In the fourth generation [5] your descendants will return here, for the wickedness of the Amorites is not yet complete. [AH]
When the sun had set and it was dark, there appeared a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch, which passed between those pieces.
[6] On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying: To your descendants I give this land, from the Wadi of Egypt to the Great River, the Euphrates, [AI]
[AJ] the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
